name: ui-moments
description: 可交互的界面与动效图鉴：整合获授权的开源组件，收录原创与AI辅助开发实验，逐项标注来源、许可和改动

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix gallery/date-picker && npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix gallery/loading-ui
scripts.build: npm --prefix gallery/date-picker run build && npm --prefix gallery/loading-ui run build && node gallery/svg-spinners/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:ldrs && npm run test:site && npm run test:loading-ui && npm --prefix gallery/date-picker test
